review: Actual per-image original PNG visual inspection; read-only, no App or device changes.
result: No new intrinsic truncation or horizontal overlap observed in this visual scope.
observations: Normal activity title and trailing share control remain distinct; location is readable below.
Date metadata contains a small gray status dot and localized collection text with the full Europe/Berlin time zone, rather than an extra title status pill.
Zero-response count and people control are distinct. Eight-response layouts retain count, three visible avatars and +5 overflow without placing count text on the control border.
At German maximum size, long location and the complete collection status/time zone wrap vertically and are readable in the corresponding scrolled captures.
Final-selection captures retain date/status metadata and separate own-availability/final-time legends; visible time labels and responder counts are readable.
Owner and participant footer actions shown in these captures remain within their horizontal bounds.
limitations: Maximum-size title, location and metadata do not fit together on the first screen; scrolling is required and represented by multiple captures.
The participant people capture places the second count line close to the lower scrolling viewport edge. This image alone does not establish a fixed layout clipping defect.
The system AssistiveTouch floating control partly covers some right-side content in the screenshots. It is separate from the App layout.
Static visual review does not independently establish interactions, VoiceOver behavior, delivery or calendar completion; full flow testing remains with the parent task.
